definitions.explanation: A freezer appliance or the freezer section of a refrigerator. Used for storing frozen food.

examples.japanese: ⟦アイス→アイス：06770_aisu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{冷凍庫|れいとうこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: Put the ice cream in the freezer.

examples.japanese: {冷凍庫|れいとうこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧いっぱい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入|はい}らない→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: The freezer is full and nothing else fits.

examples.japanese: ⟦{残|のこ}った→残る：01187_nokoru⟧⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{冷凍庫|れいとうこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦すれば→する：00392_suru⟧{一|いっ}か{月|げつ}ほど⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: If you store the leftover meat in the freezer, it will keep for about a month.

notes:
Part of a set of related appliance terms: ⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧ (refrigerator), {冷凍庫|れいとうこ} (freezer), ⟦{冷凍室|れいとうしつ}→冷凍室：22293_reitoushitsu⟧ (freezer compartment). Many Japanese refrigerators have a separate ⟦{冷凍室|れいとうしつ}→冷凍室：22293_reitoushitsu⟧ drawer, distinct from a standalone {冷凍庫|れいとうこ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冷凍庫|れいとうこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to put in the freezer)
- {冷凍庫|れいとうこ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to take out of the freezer)
- {冷凍庫|れいとうこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to store in the freezer)
